title: One window of rows from the server
description: A reader scrolls a grid over a million orders. The grid sends a query object, never SQL, for the 40 rows it shows. opengrid-server checks it against the token, the fields the client may see and the tenant's row filter, and asks the database for the window and the count, as SQL with parameters. Only the 40 rows and the total come back, about 3.3 KiB; the scroll bar is sized from the total.
